These two reports (#191 and #192) are the same crash as #175 and as the closed #180/#181 — byte-identical stack, same OS build. Here is what we could establish, and what we could not.

**They come from v1.82.0, not from a current build.** All of them carry `1.82.0 (Release 3593) x64`, Edition: Portable. Build 3593 maps to the tag push for the v1.82.0 stable on 2026-07-02 — the previous stable release. The current stable is v1.83.0.
